hook: His catamaran flipped. The water around him was churning.
narration: His sixteen foot catamaran flipped, and he was in churning water right beside it.
This was one mile southeast of Pine Key Island, Florida.
A Coast Guard boat crew from Station Saint Petersburg came alongside.
Staying next to a flipped hull matters, because a hull is far easier to spot than a head in the waves.
[short pause] They reached over the rail and pulled him out of the water.
outcome: The crew took him to Apollo Beach Marina with no medical concerns.
title: Catamaran flipped, man in churning water
description:
On April 10, 2021, a Coast Guard Station St. Petersburg 45-foot Response Boat-Medium crew pulled a man from the water after his 16-foot catamaran capsized 1 mile southeast of Pine Key Island, Florida.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video by Petty Officer 3rd Class Erik Villa Rodriguez, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/790252/coast-guard-rescues-one-person-water-1-mile-south-east-pine-key-island
